grid.layout_notes: Official rowsReels '2-3-4-4-3-2 up to 2-4-8-5-4-2'. Periscope Up grows reel 3 to 8. Binocular over reels 5–6.

win_system.notes: Ways with xWays splits from Torpedo Builder; exact base ways not printed.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: xBomb explodes non-winning (except Bonus/Wild); symbols fall; +1 win mult before collapse.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Periscope Up: reel 3 grows to 8; Periscope Wild can nudge full height on hit.

other.name: Torpedo Builder
other.how_it_works: Full boat in Binocular (reels 5–6) → 3 spins to fill 4 torpedo parts on reels 2–5 (reels 1&6 closed). Parts add +1–3 xWays or Ways Wild; launch reveals splits. Golden boat → parts only +8/+88.

other.name: Periscope Up
other.how_it_works: Reel 3 to 8; Periscope Wild; connecting 1–2 + Wild → torpedo shot; hit → nudge full height adding mult per step. Random in base/Wolf Pack; always on in Silent Hunter/Battle.

wilds.name: xBomb Wild
wilds.behavior: Subs except Bonus; explodes non-winners; +1 mult next collapse; FS mult carries.

wilds.name: Periscope Wild
wilds.behavior: Reel 3; on hit nudges full height with mult per step; miss = single Wild.

wilds.name: Ways Wild (Torpedo)
wilds.behavior: From torpedo parts on reels 3–4; splits on launch.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: Reels 1–6. 3→8 Silent Hunter; 4→9 Wolf Pack; 5→10 Battle of the Atlantic. Extra Bonus in FS → +2 spins.

multipliers.name: xBomb / Periscope mults
multipliers.behavior: Add together before pays; persist/grow in bonus modes.

specials.name: Boat / Golden Boat (Binocular)
specials.behavior: Full boat → Torpedo Builder; golden → Golden Torpedo Builder.

base_game_loop.summary: Ways cascades on expanding 6-reel grid with xBomb, Torpedo Builder (Binocular boats), Periscope Up. 3/4/5 Bonus → Silent Hunter 8 / Wolf Pack 9 / Battle 10. Boosters 1.5×/8×/20×/4,500×. Extra Spin keeps mults/torpedo progress. Cap 59,999×.

phases.name: Configure boosters
phases.what_happens: Optional Bonus 1.5×, Periscope Up 8×, Torpedo 20×, Golden Torpedo 4,500×.

phases.name: Cascade / Torpedo / Periscope
phases.what_happens: xBomb collapses; optional Torpedo Builder or Periscope Up sequences.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways after collapses/torpedo launches/periscope nudges; mults add.
base_game_loop.notes: CMS; sibling pattern to Das xBoot.

modes.name: Silent Hunter Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Periscope Up always on; Periscope nudge mult persistent for that hit spin; xBomb mult +1 for remainder of bonus.
modes.end_condition: Spins done or Nein! 59,999×; optional Extra Spin.
modes.effects: 8 FS; perpetual Periscope; growing xBomb mult.

modes.name: Wolf Pack Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Torpedo tube under 2–5 preloaded size-2; parts leave Wilds; boat launches current torpedo then reloads identical; xBomb mult accumulates; Periscope can trigger randomly.

modes.name: Battle of the Atlantic Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Silent Hunter Periscope + Wolf Pack Torpedo combined; xBomb mult accumulates.

features.name: Periscope Up
features.trigger: Random or always in some FS
features.effects: Reel 3→8; Periscope Wild nudge on hit.

options.name: Extra Spin
options.effects: After FS if cost ≤ total win.

ante_bet.notes: Boosters used instead of classic xBet.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Silent Hunter 8 / Wolf Pack 9 / Battle 10; Torpedo/Periscope; boosters; max 59999×.
